tagline.en: THUML's Vid2World — turns a pretrained video diffusion model into an interactive, action-conditioned world model.
tagline.zh: 清华 THUML 的 Vid2World——把预训练的视频扩散模型改造成可交互、动作条件的世界模型。

en: Vid2World is a research model from THUML (Tsinghua University's Machine Learning Group). Its idea is to adapt a large pretrained video diffusion model into an interactive world model, so that generation can be conditioned on actions and unfold step by step rather than as one fixed clip.

By repurposing video diffusion for interaction, the model predicts how a scene responds to actions over time — useful for simulation and world-model research. It is distributed as upstream source with an evaluation route.

In WorldFoundry the source and configuration are registered so you can resolve its config and inference route; the checkpoints and config assets are staged separately, with the runtime listing what it needs.
zh: Vid2World 是清华大学机器学习组(THUML)的研究模型。其思路是把大型预训练视频扩散模型改造为可交互的世界模型,使生成可以以动作为条件、逐步展开,而不是一次生成一段固定片段。
通过把视频扩散用于交互,该模型能预测场景随时间对动作的响应——对仿真与世界模型研究很有用。它以上游源码形式发布,并附带评测路径。
在 WorldFoundry 中,其源码与配置已被注册,你可以解析它的配置与推理路径;checkpoint 与配置素材需另行准备,运行时会列出所需内容。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Vid2World when you want an action-conditioned, interactive world model derived from video diffusion, and you can supply its checkpoints and config assets.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个由视频扩散衍生、动作条件的可交互世界模型,并能提供其 checkpoint 与配置素材时,适合使用 Vid2World。

notFor.en: It is a research codebase rather than a turnkey generator; real generation requires you to stage the checkpoints and config assets first.
notFor.zh: 它更像研究代码库而非开箱即用的生成器;真实生成前需先准备好 checkpoint 与配置素材。

en: Adapts pretrained video diffusion into an interactive world model
Distributed as upstream source with an evaluation route
